svg.aria-label: Chapter III, The Treasury. A torch-lit vault heaped with gold coins. On a stone dais stand three chests in alcoves numbered I, II and III. Chest I is glittering gold, with a luggage tag reading WORKS ON MY MACHINE hanging from its lock; the tip of a pink tongue peeks out under its lid, and the lid slowly rises and falls as if breathing. Chest II is shiny red lacquer and silver, with a hand-painted TRUST ME sign beside it and teeth marks bitten into its lid. Chest III is plain, dusty and cobwebbed, with a carved rerun rune (a circular arrow) and a small green check mark. The ape paladin, Brakka the dwarf and Gus the gelatinous cube look on from the left.

g.text: Open me… I am definitely not a mimic…
